full_judgment: 16. In this case, P.W.4 is the only alleged eye-witness. She stated that in a separate chowki she, along with the aforesaid minor children of deceased Abiruddin, were sleeping within the hut where both the deceased were sleeping in another chowki. She stated that on hearing cries of her sister Sajeda Begum, she woke up and by the light of lantern, saw accused Abdul Gafur, Tozammel, Taleb and another assaulting her sister and sister's husband with knives. But P.W.17, the Investigating Officer stated that P.W.4 stated to him that accused Taher and Abdul Gafur and one Motaleb assaulted both the deceased. This is a material contradiction. P.W.4 further stated that out of fear she did not disclose the names of the assailants as they threatened her. She further stated that after the incident she became asleep and woke up at the call of the wife of accused Taleb. P.W.4 stated in his cross-examination, “আমার মা আমাকে বলিয়াছে আমাকে কি কি বলিতে হইবে।” Though the statement of P.W.4 that she did not disclose the names of the assailants out of fear can be believed, but her conduct that after the occurrence she became asleep and only woke up when the wife of accused Taleb called her cannot be believed. This is unnatural. Furthermore as we have found that the dying declaration alleged to have been made by deceased Sajeda Begum to P.W. 3 is false and in view of the admission of P.W.4 that she was tutored to give this evidence and the aforesaid analysis of her evidence, we hold that her evidence should not be believed. Moreover, P.W.4 stated that with her, deceased Abiruddin's son Ali Azam of her age was sleeping. Non-examination of Ali Azam by the prosecution has created adverse presumption against its case.
